metadata.title: Urban Gritty Portrait with Script Overlay

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, sepia-toned extreme close-up portrait of a male subject, featuring a textured, scratched background and fluid, expressive script lettering in the upper corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's intense gaze directed at the viewer
Contrast between the smooth skin tones and the heavily distressed background
Organic flow of the script typography against the rigid horizontal lines of the headband
Monochromatic sepia palette unifying disparate textures

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, tilted at a slight angle.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, specifically the one centered in the frame, serving as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the eyes to the script in the top left, then down the curve of the face to the bottom left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper left quadrant provides textured negative space for the primary display text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm sepia/beige tones in the background and skin highlights.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal and black for shadows, headband, and clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white for small highlights and secondary graphic elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high tonal contrast between highlights and shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to earth tones and grayscale

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with varying stroke weights
letterConstructionRules: High contrast between thick downstrokes and thin upstrokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Tapered terminals that mimic ink brush strokes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast a fluid, organic script with a rigid, blocky sans-serif for secondary information.

avoid: Geometric sans-serifs for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the organic, inked feel of the primary text.
Maintains the informal yet stylish urban aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, sepia-toned portrait of a man with an intense expression, wearing a black headband. The background should be a beige, heavily scratched and distressed wall texture. Apply a film grain overlay.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, black, hand-drawn cursive script title in the top left corner. Ensure the strokes have high calligraphic contrast.

verificationChecks: Is the portrait high-contrast and sepia-toned?
Does the background have a visible scratched texture?
Is the script lettering fluid and calligraphic?
Is the composition focused on the subject's eyes?

mustRedesign: The exact facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Strong focal point on the eyes
Seamless integration of text and texture

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the textured background.
Verify the sepia tone is consistent across the entire image.
Check that the grain does not obscure the subject's features.
Confirm the script feels integrated rather than just pasted on top.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine an extreme close-up, high-contrast portrait with a heavily distressed, warm-toned background and overlay with a high-contrast, organic script for a gritty, urban editorial look.
